inputs.text: Continuous cinematic cartoon animation, preserve the exact character designs, proportions and the camera framing. The blue shark has exactly THREE short legs and THREE attached blue-and-gold sneakers, all visible and separate throughout. No cuts, changing anatomy, disappearing feet, subtitles or added writing. Real body and environmental movement, not a still-image zoom. The shark stands on the safe shoulder and watches the fast traffic. The blue bus and yellow truck drive rapidly past in the background with rotating wheels, continuous translation and a traveling shadow. The shark follows them with frightened eyes, flinches slightly, raises its small hands close to its chest and trembles. Its three feet stay planted. Tail moves subtly. Fixed camera, clear separation between the shark and passing traffic.

static image, slideshow, freeze frame, camera zoom only, fused limbs, extra limbs, disappearing feet, changing character scale, distorted faces, flickering, unstable camera, added text, speech bubbles
